description: [general] Jp Test_Oracles Ingestion 9 Findings — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence

steps.description: Navigate to the JP dashboard home page and confirm the authenticated user's name or avatar is visible, confirming the session is active.
steps.action: navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/dashboard (or the JP root route), observe the top navigation bar
steps.expected: Dashboard page renders without a 401/403 redirect. The authenticated user identity (name or avatar) is visible in the nav. No 'Session expired' or 'Unauthorized' toast appears.

steps.description: Locate the Ingestion section in the main navigation or sidebar. Click the Ingestion menu item.
steps.action: click nav link or sidebar item labelled 'Ingestion' (or equivalent route such as /ingestion or /data-ingestion)
steps.expected: The Ingestion page loads with HTTP 200. A list or table of existing ingestion entries is visible, or an empty-state message is shown if none exist. Page title or breadcrumb confirms 'Ingestion'.

steps.description: Trigger a new ingestion run (if a 'Start Ingestion', 'Add', or 'Run' CTA is present). Record the total count of findings displayed before triggering.
steps.action: observe and note current findings count displayed in the UI; click 'Start Ingestion' / 'Add' / 'Run' button if present; if no trigger button exists, proceed to step 5 to inspect existing findings
steps.expected: Either: (a) A new ingestion job is queued and a success toast/banner appears ('Ingestion started' or similar), OR (b) The page already lists ingestion runs with associated finding counts.

steps.description: Wait for the ingestion run to complete (poll or wait for status indicator to change from 'Running'/'Pending' to 'Complete'/'Done'). The spec expects exactly 9 findings.
steps.action: observe status badge or progress indicator on the ingestion run row; wait up to 30 seconds for status to reach a terminal state ('Complete', 'Done', 'Finished', or equivalent)
steps.expected: Status indicator transitions from a pending/running state to a completed state without an error badge. No 'Failed' or 'Error' label appears on the run row.

steps.description: Click into the completed ingestion run to open its detail view. Verify the finding count equals 9.
steps.action: click the ingestion run row or a 'View Details' / 'See Findings' link associated with the completed run
steps.expected: The detail view opens and displays exactly 9 findings. A numeric summary (e.g. '9 findings', '9 results', or a table with 9 rows) is visible. No 'No findings' empty state is shown.

steps.description: Inspect each of the 9 findings for data completeness. Spot-check at least 3 finding rows for required fields: title/name, severity or category, timestamp, and a detail or description field.
steps.action: scan the findings table or list; expand or click on finding rows 1, 5, and 9; read title, severity/category, timestamp, and description fields
steps.expected: All inspected findings have non-empty title, severity/category, and timestamp fields. Description or detail field is present and non-empty. No '[object Object]', 'undefined', or 'null' placeholder values are visible.

steps.description: Validate error/edge-case handling: attempt to trigger a second ingestion run immediately after the first to check for duplicate-prevention or rate-limiting behaviour.
steps.action: navigate back to the Ingestion list; click 'Start Ingestion' / 'Run' a second time if the button is re-enabled
steps.expected: Either: (a) The button is disabled or a tooltip prevents a duplicate run with a human-readable message ('A run is already in progress' or similar), OR (b) A new run is queued and listed separately without overwriting the previous 9-finding result.

steps.description: Test persistence: navigate away from the Ingestion section to the JP dashboard home, then use the browser back button or sidebar nav to return to the Ingestion section.
steps.action: click 'Dashboard' in the sidebar nav to leave Ingestion; then click 'Ingestion' in the sidebar nav to return
steps.expected: The Ingestion page re-renders and the previously completed run with 9 findings is still listed. No data loss or blank state appears. The findings count still reads 9.

steps.description: Hard-refresh the Ingestion page (Ctrl+Shift+R or equivalent) to confirm server-side persistence — findings must survive a full page reload.
steps.action: press Ctrl+Shift+R (or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac) to perform a hard reload of the Ingestion detail or list page
steps.expected: After reload, the Ingestion page shows the same completed run. The finding count is still 9. No 404, 500, or empty-state appears. The authenticated session is preserved (no redirect to login).

steps.description: Check browser console for JavaScript errors or failed network requests that occurred during the ingestion journey.
steps.action: open browser DevTools console (F12); inspect for red errors or failed XHR/fetch requests (status 4xx or 5xx) logged during steps 3–10
steps.expected: No unhandled JavaScript exceptions in the console. No network requests returned 4xx or 5xx status codes related to the ingestion feature. CORS errors are absent.

steps.description: Verify the portal add → scan trigger → jobs appear flow referenced in TEST-ORACLES: navigate to the Admin section, add or confirm a job portal entry exists, trigger a scan, and verify scan history shows the result without silent failure.
steps.action: navigate to /admin or the Admin panel; locate 'Job Portals' or 'Portal Management'; confirm at least one portal entry is listed; click 'Trigger Scan' or equivalent; wait for the scan to appear in scan history
steps.expected: The scan is listed in the scan history within 15 seconds with a non-error status. No silent failure (blank history, spinner that never resolves, or missing entry). If an error occurs, it is surfaced as a user-readable banner — not silently dropped.
